description:
Use only with the user's own likeness or content they are authorized to use. Do not use for impersonation, deception, sexual content, or content involving minors.

Places a person from one supplied photo into a supplied scene image. Cost depends on resolution (from 50 credits at 640px); returns a project id for wait_for_image_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. For attached ChatGPT files, upload with upload_chatgpt_media and pass its returned file_path. Reuse existing Magic Hour paths only from the connected account. Do not pass a filename, chat-local path or file ID as a file path.

assets.description: Person image and scene image for body swap

person_file_path.description:
Image of the person to place into the scene. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

scene_file_path.description:
Original scene image (background). This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

name.description: Optional project name for identifying this output. Omit to use the API's default project name.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Determines credits charged for the run.

name: place_person_in_scene

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the image. We charge credits right when the request is made. 

If an error occurred while generating the image(s), credits will be refunded and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the image. Use it with the [Get image Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/image-projects/get-image-details) to fetch status and downloads.
